summary: Iteration 37 Connect Work multi-source rewrite: 18/18 backend pytest tests passed and full frontend regression passed. Verified providers directory (5 setup_required OAuth + 6 coming_soon), auth-url 400/401 behavior for unconfigured providers, Figma OAuth env activation smoke (auth URL construction with client_id/redirect_uri/scope/state + bogus-state callback returns 400 HTML) with clean .env restoration, multi-source seeded preview → establish creates 1 project + 2 github connections + 3 memory items + 2 SOURCE_CONNECTED events, duplicate detection returns 409, Ask Bracket returns grounded answer with sources, memory confirm/ignore work, disconnect leaves the other connection intact and logs SOURCE_DISCONNECTED. Frontend /app/connect renders 11 cards with real simple-icons CDN logos (gmail/figma/github/notion loaded naturalWidth=150), SETUP_REQUIRED chips on 5 OAuth providers, coming_soon cards disabled, clicking Figma shows the admin-config info toast and NO token/PAT input appears anywhere, search filter works. Project overview regression shows ConnectedWorkPanel with both source rows, memory items with Confirm/Keep as context/Ignore buttons, and Ask Bracket input. No 5xx or unexpected tracebacks in backend logs.

issues: Slack simple-icons CDN image failed to load in the test run (naturalWidth=0), lucide Slack fallback icon rendered instead. Gmail/Figma/GitHub/Notion loaded fine. Likely a transient CDN hiccup — the onError fallback works correctly so users still see a valid icon. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: connectors.py is 1090+ lines — consider splitting into provider-specific modules (figma.py, github.py, notion.py, slack.py, gmail.py) plus a shared oauth.py/routes.py; well past the 700-line guideline.
OAUTH_CONF is evaluated at import time from os.environ, so admins toggling env vars must restart backend (working as designed — documented behavior).
PROVIDER_META.slack has slug 'slack' but CDN load failed on one run; consider preloading logos or shipping local SVGs to avoid CDN dependency for a production UX.
Establish route deletes preview after use — good; back-compat path for legacy flat previews preserved (nice).
seed_data_creation: Test file seeds and cleans up its own connect_previews. Frontend regression seeded one project (7ef50c0c-...) which was deleted after the run — DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 fully passed. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_37_connect_multi.py is idempotent — it temporarily appends 2 lines to /app/backend/.env for the Figma smoke test then removes them and restarts backend. Backend .env verified restored (22 lines, no FIGMA_*). Safe to run repeatedly.
